2865.sent:
// One HMAC signature reused across >1 (taskID,artifactName) tuple on the Gitea V4 artifact handlers = CVE-2026-58426 boundary-shift forgery.
CommonSecurityLog
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where RequestURL has_any ("DownloadArtifact","UploadArtifact")
| where RequestURL has "sig="
| extend Sig = extract(@"[?&]sig=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
| extend TaskID = extract(@"[?&]taskID=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
| extend ArtifactName = extract(@"[?&]artifactName=([^&]+)", 1, RequestURL)
| where isnotempty(Sig)
| extend Tuple = strcat(TaskID, "|", ArtifactName)
| summarize DistinctTuples = dcount(Tuple), Tuples = make_set(Tuple, 10), Methods = make_set(RequestMethod, 5), SrcIPs = make_set(SourceIP, 10), Requests = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Sig, DestinationHostName
| where DistinctTuples > 1   // a valid sig should only ever pair with one fixed tuple
| order by DistinctTuples desc
2865.spl:
| tstats `summariesonly` count, values(Web.src) as src, values(Web.http_method) as http_method, min(_time) as firstTime, max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web where (Web.url="*DownloadArtifact*" OR Web.url="*UploadArtifact*") Web.url="*sig=*" by Web.url, Web.dest
| `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`
| rex field=url "[?&]sig=(?<sig>[^&]+)"
| rex field=url "[?&]taskID=(?<taskID>[^&]+)"
| rex field=url "[?&]artifactName=(?<artifactName>[^&]+)"
| eval tuple=taskID."|".artifactName
| stats dc(tuple) as distinct_tuples, values(tuple) as tuples, values(src) as src, values(http_method) as methods, sum(count) as requests, min(firstTime) as firstTime, max(lastTime) as lastTime by sig, dest
| where distinct_tuples > 1
| sort - distinct_tuples

2961.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — Unpacking the AsyncAPI npm supply chain compromise and import-time payload deliv
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("node.js", "sync.js", "index.js") or FolderPath has_any ("%LOCALAPPDATA%\NodeJS\sync.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("%LOCALAPPDATA%\NodeJS\sync.js", "/Library/Application") or FileName in~ ("node.js", "sync.js", "index.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2961.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — Unpacking the AsyncAPI npm supply chain compromise and import-time payload deliv ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("node.js","sync.js","index.js") OR Processes.process_path="*%LOCALAPPDATA%\NodeJS\sync.js*")
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*%LOCALAPPDATA%\NodeJS\sync.js*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/Library/Application*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("node.js","sync.js","index.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

2992.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — OkoBot: new sophisticated malware framework targets cryptocurrency users
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("termsrv.dll", "msconfig.exe", "hdutil.exe", "extl.exe", "msedge.dll", "chrome.dll", "volume2.exe", "protobuf.dll", "version.dll", "ext_daemon.exe", "seedhunter_x64.exe", "keylog_x64.dll", "oko.dll", "go.bat") or FolderPath has_any ("%USERPROFILE%\.ssh\go.bat", "%PROGRAMDATA%\HDVideo\HDUtil.exe"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("%USERPROFILE%\.ssh\go.bat", "%PROGRAMDATA%\HDVideo\HDUtil.exe") or FileName in~ ("termsrv.dll", "msconfig.exe", "hdutil.exe", "extl.exe", "msedge.dll", "chrome.dll", "volume2.exe", "protobuf.dll", "version.dll", "ext_daemon.exe", "seedhunter_x64.exe", "keylog_x64.dll", "oko.dll", "go.bat"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
2992.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — OkoBot: new sophisticated malware framework targets cryptocurrency users ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("termsrv.dll","msconfig.exe","hdutil.exe","extl.exe","msedge.dll","chrome.dll","volume2.exe","protobuf.dll","version.dll","ext_daemon.exe","seedhunter_x64.exe","keylog_x64.dll","oko.dll","go.bat") OR Processes.process_path="*%USERPROFILE%\.ssh\go.bat*" OR Processes.process_path="*%PROGRAMDATA%\HDVideo\HDUtil.exe*")
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*%USERPROFILE%\.ssh\go.bat*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*%PROGRAMDATA%\HDVideo\HDUtil.exe*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("termsrv.dll","msconfig.exe","hdutil.exe","extl.exe","msedge.dll","chrome.dll","volume2.exe","protobuf.dll","version.dll","ext_daemon.exe","seedhunter_x64.exe","keylog_x64.dll","oko.dll","go.bat"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]
